title: Sovra Phase 12 Domain Schemas (FTF-1201 — LiteLLM registration capability detection)
description: Frozen shared domain schemas for the read-only registration-capability detection result (Section 3/38/45/66/77/81). Field constraints (the enum) are copied verbatim from the single real enforcing source — packages/litellm_client/litellm_registration_capability_detection.py's own RegistrationCapabilityState (tested in tests/tasks/test_ftf_1201.py) — so this file cannot silently drift from the code that actually computes this result.

RegistrationCapabilityState.description: Never defaults to capable. management_capable is reported only when a genuine proxy_admin role is actually observed on a real gateway response.

RegistrationCapabilityResult.description: Content-free by construction: detail never carries the resolved credential or a raw gateway response body; observed_role is the gateway's own real, non-secret role label, never the credential itself.
